the stage it marks: lead, and mql where it meets the criteria
the moves: assign; engage (the new-lead cadence); advance: confirm, next step or convert

what it means: Being worked, the data and the audience not confirmed yet
the moves: engage (its own cadence); advance: confirm the data and the audience, set the next step, or convert

what it means: The rep confirmed the data and the audience: a real business the offer is for
the moves: engage (its own cadence); advance: set the next step or convert

what it means: The next step is out: the application, the proposal or the demo
the stage it marks: sal, on the way to sql
the moves: engage (its own cadence); advance: follow up or convert

what it means: The rep converted the lead to an opportunity
Went quiet before it was confirmed: the hand raise is set to off
the moves: A lighter cadence, mostly email. A new hand raise moves it back to active at the same status

what it means: Went quiet after it was confirmed
the moves: A lighter cadence. Ends qualified (keep nurturing) or non-qualified

what it means: Went quiet with the application out
the moves: A lighter cadence. A new hand raise moves it back to active

what it means: Never a fit: the business closed, out of the market
the moves: lost_at and a lost_reason from a fixed list. Not worked again

what it means: Not now: too small today, the wrong time
the moves: lost_at and a lost_reason. Checked again on a schedule

what it means: A second record for a lead already in the CRM, from an import that missed the match or a mistyped email. It points to the lead it repeats
the moves: Labeled, never merged or deleted. Every performance number leaves it out (analysis/rules)

what it means: A test record, from a launch check or QA
the moves: Labeled, never deleted. Every performance number leaves it out (analysis/rules)

what it means: Not a lead for the offer: a job seeker, an existing customer asking for support
the moves: Labeled, never deleted, and passed to whoever handles it. Every performance number leaves it out (analysis/rules)

what it means: Junk that got past the form's spam rules: no real person or business behind it
the moves: Labeled, never deleted. Every performance number leaves it out (analysis/rules)
